web-guide-idea-67.audience: Students who benefit from a shared study routine.
web-guide-idea-67.offer: Host structured work blocks with goals and check-ins. You are selling facilitation and accountability, not tutoring every subject.
web-guide-idea-67.steps.0: Ask each person to name a realistic goal.
web-guide-idea-67.steps.1: Run a quiet focus block and a short check-in.
web-guide-idea-67.steps.2: Review progress and set the next independent step.
web-guide-idea-67.equipment: A phone, charger and timer. Participants bring their own study materials.
web-guide-idea-67.returnReason: Use a reliable schedule and help people notice consistent effort across weeks.
web-guide-idea-67.promotion: Show the session timetable and explain when conversation happens and when the room is quiet.
web-guide-idea-67.metadataTitle: Study With Me Club — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-67.metadataDescription: Set shared goals, work quietly and check in during structured breaks to keep each other accountable. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
